phase_name: ESP32 TCP client lifecycle and full-stack wireless verification

completed_tasks.name: Identify premature TCP client closure and queued connection causes
Remove duplicate relay/fleet identity exchange and repair launcher routing
Compile and flash 30-second idle-grace firmware to COM3 and COM4
Run physical reconnect and UDP matrix
completed_tasks.progress: JSON result ok=true; 12/12 identity reconnect cases and UDP START/SENSORS/frame/STOP passed across both boards. A serial teardown thread exception made the process exit nonzero after the successful result.

remaining_tasks.name: Run final ROS/OpenSim/GUI full cycle with the newly flashed firmware

blockers.description: Final post-flash ROS/OpenSim/GUI end-to-end verification has not been run yet.
blockers.workaround: Start from the exact launcher command and verification sequence in .planning/.continue-here.md.

decisions.decision: Use a 30000 ms firmware TCP idle grace.
decisions.rationale: The real WSL/ROS startup measured about 5.5 seconds between connection and the next control command, crossing the former 5000 ms boundary.

decisions.decision: The Windows relay owns the physical IDENTITY exchange and returns its bounded verified inventory to fleet_bridge_node.
decisions.rationale: Forwarding a second IDENTITY query caused duplicate and interleaved inventory fragments.

decisions.decision: Keep one validated ESP socket for identity and control instead of opening a fresh post-probe socket.
decisions.rationale: The fresh-socket experiment intermittently lost REDPITAYA/START commands; the single-socket relay-only handshake completed normally.

next_action: Run the complete hotspot launcher with the verified master/slave routes, wait at least 30 seconds, then verify relay/fleet logs, both ROS IMU rates, fleet registry, OpenSim fresh/ready status, and the GUI at port 5173.
context_notes: Both boards are flashed and the physical matrix passed. All STEP ESP relay, ROS, OpenSim, serial-drain, and workspace Vite processes were stopped for the pause. The repository was already broadly dirty; preserve unrelated user changes.
